shared_elements: repeated rows of similar elements (boat hulls with crew strokes / line of figures)
small quadruped animal figures (A only? — A has quadrupeds)
justification: The only real overlap is that both surfaces depict upright human figures, some holding objects, and both use repetition of similar units (boats with crew-strokes in A, a file of robed men in B); this is the sort of coincidence any two traditions could produce. Everything specific differs: A is dominated by profile boats, cup marks and matchstick bodies rendered as bare outlines scattered over the rock, while B is a single horizontal procession of modelled, garment-draped figures with elaborate headgear linking hands in a formal register.
